business_interpretation: The highest-spending established customers, typically on fiber optic with several add-ons. Their risk depends heavily on contract type, so the segment mixes very secure and very exposed accounts.
recommended_action: Relationship management: premium or priority support, a periodic plan-fit review so customers are not paying for services they do not use, and loyalty benefits tied to a longer contract for those on month-to-month terms.

main_characteristics: Median tenure 27 months; 100% month-to-month; 51% fiber optic; 44% electronic check; average 1.7 add-on services
business_interpretation: Customers who have stayed beyond their first year without committing to a contract. They have shown some loyalty but can still leave in any month.
recommended_action: Commitment and value building: offer contract options with clear benefits, promote automatic payment, and bundle protective add-ons such as Online Security and Tech Support.
